pr_title: Move broadcast of key updates into sync, fixup of externaljwt generation / test
pr_body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

1. Bugfix: Moves broadcast into syncKeys method, so any change to keys (periodic or on-demand) always notifies listeners immediately.
2. Test flake fix: Address race between setting new keys and ensuring they've been read (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/128190#issuecomment-2462857707)
3. Add proto definition file needed for local generation (fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128672)



#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
NONE
```

/assign @enj
/sig auth

issue_context.title: Issue with protobindings codegen
issue_context.body:
Hello, ever since yesterday with https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/128190 merged I've been having some issues with codegen for protobindings. Not sure if there's a configuration that I might be missing, want to see if anyone else has encountered.

```
kubernetes ❯ ./hack/update-codegen.sh protobindings 
+++ [1107 18:14:20] Generating protobuf bindings for 9 targets
google/protobuf/timestamp.proto: File not found.
api.proto:24:1: Import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto" was not found or had errors.
api.proto:77:5: "google.protobuf.Timestamp" is not defined.
!!! [1107 18:14:34] Call tree:
!!! [1107 18:14:34]  1: ~/gospace/src/k8s.io/kubernetes/hack/lib/protoc.sh:40 kube::protoc::protoc(...)
!!! [1107 18:14:34]  2: hack/_update-generated-proto-bindings-dockerized.sh:50 kube::protoc::generate_proto(...)
!!! [1107 18:14:34] Call tree:
!!! [1107 18:14:34]  1: ~/gospace/src/k8s.io/kubernetes/hack/lib/protoc.sh:40 kube::protoc::protoc(...)
!!! [1107 18:14:34]  2: hack/_update-generated-proto-bindings-dockerized.sh:50 kube::protoc::generate_proto(...)
!!! [1107 18:14:34] Call tree:
!!! [1107 18:14:34]  1: ./hack/update-codegen.sh:888 codegen::protobindings(...)
```

```
kubernetes took 15s ❯ which protoc
~/gospace/src/k8s.io/kubernetes/third_party/protoc/protoc
kubernetes ❯ protoc --version  
libprotoc 23.4
```

/cc @liggitt @HarshalNeelkamal
